citations.quote: Twelve services now provision through the shared modules with per-environment state. Drift detection runs nightly and opens a ticket rather than auto-applying.
Audited every deployment against 30-day p95 utilisation and corrected 180 pod specs.
This certification was valid through 14 March 2024 and has since expired. It has not been renewed.

rationale: The evidence shows substantial hands-on Kubernetes and Terraform work across a 43-service production estate (a 12-service module migration, drift detection, and rightsizing 180 pod specs), which supports advanced-level use at production scale, but the CKA certification has expired and nothing in the evidence directly establishes the 'expert' level the claim states.
